Alger, 25 septembre 2026 (Algeria Tech): Algiers, September 25, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — Huawei Algeria has completed the first phase of its Seeds for the Future 2026 program, marking this milestone with a series of expert keynote speeches and a celebration of student achievements.
Bilan et interventions d'experts lors de: Review and expert presentations during the final day
La dernière journée du programme Seeds f: The final day of the Seeds for the Future 2026 program was marked by discussions and new perspectives for the participating students. Expert Kheira Lakhdari discussed the transformation of research into concrete on-the-ground impacts, while Tarik Guenab interacted with the students by answering their questions and providing practical feedback.
Du côté des technologies avancées, Tahar: Regarding advanced technologies, Tahar Ait Mohammed, an IT and equipment expert at Huawei, introduced more complex systems to the students. Meanwhile, Mounir Ouadi, head of the artificial intelligence center of excellence, highlighted the prospects of Edge AI, bringing an innovative dimension to this training session.
La journée s'est achevée par la célébrat: The day concluded with the celebration of the accomplishments of students who successfully completed the first part of this curriculum, although the journey continues.
